description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components that can output log data to various targets and potentially form a chain of log nodes for complex logging flows.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system component that can output log messages to one or more targets, allowing for chaining and filtering of logs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the LogNode to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
